g.text: S2 Retrieval exposure changes the RAG denominator
Pipeline ASR includes cases where poison was not retrieved. The exposed subset conditions on poisoned material being retrieved.
The subsets can differ across configurations and models; these are descriptive rates, not a matched-case causal estimate.
